annotation.title_clean: Tekoälyn tuottaman sisällön merkitsemistä koskevat EU:n kuvakkeet
annotation.title_en: EU icons for labelling AI-generated content
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page (Finnish machine translation) presenting voluntary EU icons for labelling AI-generated or manipulated content, supporting deployers' compliance with AI Act Article 50(4) transparency duties for deepfakes and AI-generated public-interest text. Covers exceptions, display specifications, accessibility and licensing.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU icon set (4 variants) is free to use and part of Section 2 of the Code of Practice on AI-generated content labelling
Icons support AI Act Art. 50(4) disclosure of deepfakes and unreviewed AI-generated public-interest text
Use of icons is voluntary, but Art. 50 obligations are mandatory; icon use does not guarantee compliance
Exceptions for artistic/satirical works, law-enforcement uses, and human-reviewed text with editorial responsibility
Display specs: clearly visible at first exposure, embedded, accessibility measures such as ARIA labels
